import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { activeStorageAttachments } from "../../../backend/schema/active_storage_attachments";

export const activeStorageAttachmentsCms = customizeTable<typeof activeStorageAttachments>("active_storage_attachments", {
    hideFromNavigation: true,
    display: {
        title: "name"
    },
    fields: {
        name: {
            multiline: true
        },
        recordType: {
            multiline: true
        }
    }
});
